title: Register Society form has no 'Area or locality' field, which the spec lists as required
steps: 1. Sign in as 9000000030, open /c/k7m2x9. 2. Click Register society. 3. Look at the Address section.
expected: Address section has Street address, Landmark, Area or locality (required), City, State, PIN code, Country.
actual: No Area or locality field exists in the form, and the societies table has no column for it (address_line, landmark, city, state, pincode, country only). Also the society name rule is 3-100 characters where the spec says 2-120.
environment: Local dev: Next.js 15 dev server http://localhost:3000, local Supabase, headless Chrome (Playwright), 2026-11-10

title: Wrong OTP is reported as 'This OTP has expired. Request a new one.'
steps: 1. /login, Society authority (or Resident), enter 9000000002, Send OTP. 2. On /verify type 111111 and press Verify.
expected: A 'wrong code, N attempts left' style message; the code is still valid so the user should simply retype it.
actual: GoTrue returns 403 and the screen shows 'This OTP has expired. Request a new one.' for a code that was merely wrong. Users are pushed to request a new OTP (and then hit the 60 s resend limit). Six wrong codes in a row did not lock the number; the correct code still worked afterwards.
api_error: POST /auth/v1/verify -> 403 (otp_expired: Token has expired or is invalid)
environment: Local dev: Next.js 15 dev server http://localhost:3000, local Supabase, headless Chrome (Playwright), 2026-11-10

title: Returning authority with a PIN is signed in without the PIN step when the active society has no flats
steps: 1. 9000000001 is authority of QA-T Maple Residency and QA-T Maple Annex and has set PIN 1357 (pin_set=true). 2. Active membership is Maple Annex (setup not done, 0 flats). 3. Sign in at /login with 9000000001, enter OTP 123456.
expected: After the OTP, 'One more step - your PIN' is shown, as it is for the same user when the active society has flats.
actual: OTP -> /onboarding -> /setup with no PIN prompt. lib/auth/loginMode.js returns 'authority' when flats_in_society is 0 even if pin_set is true, and the authority branch of /verify never asks for the PIN. The PIN second factor is skipped (UI-level; server-side non-enforcement is SEC-003).
environment: Local dev: Next.js 15 dev server http://localhost:3000, local Supabase, headless Chrome (Playwright), 2026-11-10

title: Authority of two societies cannot choose which one to open after both are claimed; lands in an arbitrary society with no switcher on /setup
steps: 1. 9000000001 claims QA-T Maple Residency (picker) and later QA-T Maple Annex. 2. Save a draft in Maple Residency's wizard. 3. Sign in again.
expected: A society picker (or a switcher on /setup) so the user can return to the society whose draft they left.
actual: The picker only appears while a society is unclaimed. The next sign-ins went straight to Maple Annex's /setup. /setup has no sidebar or society switcher, so the Maple Residency draft is unreachable from the UI (only via set_active_society, which the sidebar uses on other pages).
environment: Local dev: Next.js 15 dev server http://localhost:3000, local Supabase, headless Chrome (Playwright), 2026-11-10

title: No way to sign out from the setup wizard
steps: 1. Sign in as a new authority (9000000001) and land on /setup. 2. Look for Sign out / profile menu.
expected: A sign-out control (needed on shared devices) as on other signed-in screens.
actual: The /setup layout is a bare header with the app name only; no sign-out, profile menu or navigation. /logout returns 404. The only exit is clearing browser data.
environment: Local dev: Next.js 15 dev server http://localhost:3000, local Supabase, headless Chrome (Playwright), 2026-11-10

title: Import template lacks Family Member, Relationship and Vehicle Number columns
steps: 1. Sign in as authority 9000000001 (QA-T Maple Residency). 2. Open /import, click Download template. 3. Open the Residents sheet.
expected: Columns: Society Code, Wing, Floor, Flat, Full Name, Resident Type, Mobile, Email, Family Member, Relationship, Vehicle Number.
actual: Only Society Code, Wing, Floor, Flat, Full Name, Resident Type, Mobile, Email. There is no way to import a family member's relationship or vehicle numbers.
